out.title: Ashish Chandra appointed Chief Manufacturing Officer; Raj Narayanan to relinquish
out.summary: Ashish Chandra appointed Chief Manufacturing Officer (Designate) from 16 Sep 2026, taking full charge 1 Apr 2027; E R Raj Narayanan relinquishes the role on 31 Mar 2027 after a planned transition.

person.name: Ashish Chandra
person.bio: ~33 years post-qualification manufacturing experience; leadership in large-scale operations, project execution, operational transformation; Mechanical Engineer, Punjab Engineering College; Senior Leadership Programme, Brown University.
